digest.component_or_area: development process and audit decision framework
propositions: Six process-improvement recommendations from a 2026-08-15 frozen audit must be evaluated against prior audits, decisions, and implementations to identify new evidence warranting reconsideration versus reaffirmation of prior rationale

Escaped-defect metadata (detected_by field) was implemented with fail-open optional capture at creation seams, not mandatory schema; coverage remains low (1.1%) and should be expanded via automatic stamping at known automated-filer boundaries rather than globally required

Deterministic plan preflight currently enforces P1-P11 mechanical conditions with advisory fail-open semantics; extension to new criteria requires offline replay validation, false-positive ceilings, and demonstrated discrimination between pass and block cohorts before promotion

Completion-failure classification should derive stable reason categories from historical 351 failure sidecars offline before adding schema; all non-PASS outcomes mix code defects, unmet ACs, missing evidence, gaps, environment failures, and tool defects and must not be conflated with escaped bugs

Risk-tiered review must be piloted without merge enforcement, evaluating prospective signals available before/during review (security/store/concurrency surfaces, file impact, module complexity, plan failures, diff breadth) and measuring defect/revert rates by tier before threshold selection

Autonomous governance already has OSS intake, onboarding, Gerrit votes, and durable force-close reasons; the remaining problem is author-model independence from reviewer models and operational continuity, not human-review approval or rotation
